source_text:
Πτέρυγα δέ τις ὅλην ζώσης αὐτῆς ἐξελὼν ἅτε λιστρίῳ ἐς
ἄρυσιν ποτοῦ χρήσθω, ὀλιγάκις μὲν ἂν πρὸς ὀλίγον, πολλάκις δὲ καὶ ἀμφοτέραις ἢν
μακρὰς χρῄζῃ τις ἀγρυπνίας· ἂν δέ τις ἀπλήστως τούτῳ χρήσηται τῷ ποτῷ, ἄϋπνος
ἐς τὸ πάμπαν μενεῖ. Εἰ δέ πῃ καὶ παῖξαι θέλοις ἐς ἀγρυπνίαν ἐμβαλών, ζώσης τὴν
κεφαλὴν ἀφελὼν τῷ προσκεφαλαίῳ ἔνθα καθεύδειν αὐτῷ σύνηθες ἔρραψον· ὃ δὲ οὐ
κοιμήσεται ὡς ὅλην αὐτὴν περιημμένος· καὶ γὰρ τὸν οὕτως αὐτὴν περικείμενον διὰ
παντὸς ἄϋπνον τηρεῖ. Νυκτὸς εἶ τέκνον ὦ Ὕπνε· νυκτὸς ὄρνις σε νικᾷ· εἰ καὶ
πτερόεις τυγχάνεις, προλαμβάνω σε κἀγὼ ἄλλῳ πτερῷ. Οὕτως οἱ Πασιθέας πρὸς
Ὕπνον γάμοι. Ἀγρυπνοῦσι μὲν ὁ Ἔρως· ἐγγύη δὲ ὑπὸ Ἥρατούτου ἡ κλοπὴ τοῦ
πτεροῦ. Τί δὲ θαῦμα εἰ καὶ τοῦτο παρὰ Χαρί των ἔλαβεν ἡ Ἥρα. Καὶ γὰρ παρὰ τῆς
Ἀφροδίτης τοὺς κεστοὺς ἐδανείσατο. Εἰ μὲν οὖν ἐπέγνως ἐκ συμβόλων τὸ ζῷον (οὐ
γὰρ ἀσαφῶς ἢ δυσλήπτως ἔκκειται), τάχα ἐπαινοῖο· εἰ δ' οὖν, ἐπὶ τέλει κείμενον
εὑρήσεις ἐν πενταγώνῳ θʹ, πρὸς σημείοις μέσων ἐναρμονίου τρόπου τοῦ Λυδίου
[πρὸς τοῖς τελευταίοις δ' ἐστίν], πῖ καὶ σίγμα ἀπεστραμμένον.
pass_a_gloss: A-wing but someone whole of-living it having-pulled-out as with-a-scraper into drawing of-drink let-him-use, infrequently if toward a-little, often and with-both if long he-need someone of-watches; if but someone insatiably this should-use the drink, sleepless into the altogether he-will-remain. If somewhere also to-play you-should-wish into sleeplessness having-cast, of-a-living the head having-taken-off to-the pillow where to-sleep to-him customary sew; and he will-not sleep as the-whole it having-hung-about; for also the thus it wearing through all sleepless it-keeps. Of-Night you-are child O Sleep; of-night a-bird you beats; if even winged you-happen-to-be, I-forestall you I-too with-another wing. Thus the of-Pasithea toward Sleep marriages. They-stay-awake Eros; pledge under Hera-toutou the theft of-the wing. What wonder if also this from Charites received Hera. For also from Aphrodite the cestuses she-borrowed. If then you-recognized from tokens the animal (not for unclearly or hard-to-grasp it-is-set-out), perhaps you-might-be-praised; if not, at the-end lying you-will-find in pentagon 9, toward signs of-middles of-enharmonic mode the Lydian [toward the last it-is], pi and sigma turned-back.
pass_b_english: Let someone pull out a whole wing of it while it is alive and use it as a scraper-scoop for drawing drink — infrequently if for a short time, but often and with both wings if someone needs long watches. If someone uses this drink without measure, he will remain sleepless altogether.

If you should also wish to play a trick by throwing someone into sleeplessness, take the head of a living one and sew it to the pillow where it is his custom to sleep. He will not sleep, as if he had hung the whole creature about him; for it keeps sleepless throughout the one who wears it so.
You are Night's child, O Sleep; a bird of night beats you. Even if you happen to be winged, I too forestall you with another wing. Thus the marriage of Pasithea to Sleep.
Eros stays awake; and the theft of the wing is the pledge under Hera of this. What wonder if Hera received this too from the Charites? For she borrowed the cestus-bands from Aphrodite.

If then you recognized the animal from the tokens — for it is not set out unclearly or hard to grasp — you might perhaps be praised. If not, you will find it lying at the end in pentagon 9, toward the signs of the middles of the enharmonic Lydian mode — and it is toward the last ones — pi and a reversed sigma.

choices.why: A small hoe/scraper used to draw drink from the live wing. Not a stirrer, and not masonry trowel as the main sense here.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
